segments.t: Welcome to Kukhnya Season 2, Episode 18. In the kitchen, Chef Barinov snaps at Max over salting a soup and is then blindsided when sous-chef Lyova walks out in street clothes, reminding Viktor Petrovich that he signed his vacation request while drunk.
Не понял, а ты куда собрался?
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'I salted it two minutes ago.' The meaning hinges on 'to salt' working together with 'back' in spoken Russian.
'Do not get smart with me.' Vika anchors the line on 'not', while 'to act smart' completes the thought.
Не понял, а ты куда собрался?
'Wait a minute, where do you think you are going?' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'not', while 'got ready' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'Actually, I am on vacation.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'actually' and 'I' in a few short words.
'You signed the request form yourself.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'to sign'.
'Was I drunk when I signed it?' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'there was' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Well, then it does not count.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'to be considered' to negate the statement.
'You should have warned me beforehand.' In Russian, the idea of 'to warn' flows naturally into 'there was' without extra filler words.
'It is not my fault.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'guilty'. Vika answers right away.
'I do not know anything about that.' The meaning hinges on 'nothing' working together with 'know' in spoken Russian.
'I have plans of my own...' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'by', while 'me' completes the thought.
'Will they pay us extra for covering?' Vika raises the pitch on 'they will' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'I still do not want to do it anyway.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'want' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Не понял, а ты куда собрался?
When you watch Scene 1 of Episode 18, listen out for the exchange around lyova's sudden vacation — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
